meta.title: Ponytail (lazy senior mode)
meta.description: A full DSH port of DietrichGebert/ponytail: the always-on lazy senior developer mode and its seven-rung ladder (YAGNI down to the minimum implementation), with six native Chinese skills (core, review, audit, debt, gain, help) and zero tool registrations.
panel.title: Ponytail Config
mode.title: Intensity Level
mode.hint: Controls how strongly the ladder prompt is injected. Changes apply immediately and are written to the config file for all sessions.
mode.lockedHint: A higher-priority configuration is in effect; changes here will not affect the actual runtime level.
skills.title: Native Skills
skills.hint: Disabled skills disappear from the slash menu and are not loaded by the model.
